cook_sausage:
def cook_sausage():
	#0.Place Pan on Stove
	NAVIGATE_TO('Pan')
	GRASP('Pan')
	NAVIGATE_TO('Stove')
	PLACE_ON_TOP('Stove')
	#1.Place Sausage in Pan
	NAVIGATE_TO('Sausage')
	GRASP('Sausage')
	NAVIGATE_TO('Pan')
	PLACE_INSIDE('Pan')
	#2.Start Stove for Cooking Sausage
	NAVIGATE_TO('Stove')
	TOGGLE_ON('Stove')
	#3.Wait until sausage is cooked
	wait(100.0)
	#4.Turn Off Stove
	NAVIGATE_TO('Stove')
	TOGGLE_OFF('Stove')
